_doc: CITED published numbers for L13 — NOT computed in this repo. Use verbatim with source. The DPR static ladder (Karpukhin Table 3) and the RocketQA denoising ablation are the deck's anchor figures; the toy (l13-negatives.json) reproduces the RocketQA SHAPE, not these magnitudes.
_source: _research/gen_l13_negatives.py (static, cited): DPR, RocketQA, ANCE, STAR/ADORE, TAS-B, AR2, SimCSE

dprTable3.note: Gold-7 no-in-batch 63.1 -> +in-batch 69.1 -> 127 in-batch 73.0 -> +1 BM25 hard neg (best) 78.0; a 2nd BM25 neg does not help.
dprTable3.source: Karpukhin et al., 'Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain QA', EMNLP 2020 (arXiv:2004.04906)

rocketqaAblation.note: Undenoised hard negs DROP below in-batch (false negatives); a cross-encoder denoiser recovers and exceeds.

ance.metric: MS MARCO dev MRR@10 / NQ top-20
ance.source: Xiong et al., 'Approximate Nearest Neighbor Negative Contrastive Learning (ANCE)', ICLR 2021 (arXiv:2007.00808)

starAdore.source: Zhan et al., 'Optimizing Dense Retrieval Model Training with Hard Negatives (STAR/ADORE)', SIGIR 2021 (arXiv:2104.08051)

tasb.source: Hofstaetter et al., 'Efficiently Teaching an Effective Dense Retriever with Balanced Topic-Aware Sampling (TAS-B)', SIGIR 2021 (arXiv:2104.06967)

simcse.note: Supervised SimCSE uses the NLI contradiction sentence as a HARD negative.

marginMse.method: distil the teacher MARGIN S(q,p+)-S(q,p-), not the 0/1 label (graceful with false negatives)
marginMse.source: Hofstaetter et al., 'Improving Efficient Neural Ranking Models with Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation (Margin-MSE)', arXiv:2010.02666
